Hi Emma —

We missed you on today’s technical walkthrough (I waited in the meeting from 10:00–10:15). I hope everything is OK on your end. No problem — we can absolutely rebook.

Quick notes and options so we can move fast:
- We can do a condensed 30-minute session focused on the integration path and latency/throughput numbers you asked about.
- Proposed windows (PDT): Thu 3/29 9:00–9:30, Thu 3/29 11:00–11:30, Fri 3/30 8:30–9:00.
- If you prefer, we can record a short 12–15 minute demo and follow with an async Q&A.

Prep: I attached a short prep checklist and the sandbox setup guide (sandbox credentials will be provided once slot is confirmed).

Sergio (SE) and Aditya (PM) are looped in to cover technical integration and rollout planning respectively — Sergio can focus the demo on the connector and end-to-end latency.

Could you confirm one of the slots above (or send two that work) and whether 30 minutes is fine?

Thanks — apologies again for the missed slot.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

Emma — thanks, 11:00–11:30 PDT on Thu 3/29 is booked on our side. Calendar invite sent (meeting link in the invite).

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–3 min: Quick intros & success criteria (Lauren)
- 3–14 min: Integration walkthrough (Sergio) — connector pattern, auth, sample code
- 14–22 min: Performance & scale (Sergio) — end-to-end latency, batching behavior, KV cache expectations
- 22–28 min: Rollout considerations (Aditya) — staging -> prod, monitoring & rollback policy
- 28–30 min: Quick next steps & action items

Attachments again: sandbox-setup-instructions.md and prep-checklist.pdf. Sergio — would you prioritize a 5–7 minute demo of the connector plus a short latency slide set? Aditya — we’ll need a short note on rollout timeline and SLOs to share with Emma after the call.

Emma — I’ll post the sandbox credentials to this thread 30 minutes before the meeting so your infra team can test connectivity. If anything changes, ping me and we’ll pivot to the recorded option.

Lauren
